items.title: Live: Heavyweight stocks lift Sensex, Nifty by 1%; IT sector in focus | Closing Bell
items.description:
Indian markets staged a strong comeback, shrugging off geopolitical concerns as the Sensex surged over 900 points and the Nifty reclaimed 24,250. IT stocks extended gains for the fourth straight session, while auto, realty, metal and pharma stocks remained in focus.

Join Lovisha Darad in conversation with market experts as they decode the day's biggest market movers, FII-DII trends, sectoral action, and what investors should watch ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy decision.
